meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenCode 配置管理多种 AI 模型提供商
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器化环境中切换不同 AI 模型提供商
copy.tagline_en: Manage multiple AI model providers via OpenCode config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to switch between AI model providers in containerized environments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 OpenCode 使用外部 AI 模型，如 DeepSeek、OpenRouter 等，并按配置切换模型提供商。
howto.when: 当代理组配置为使用 OpenCode 提供商，并设置好 OPENCODE_PROVIDER 等环境变量后触发。

say.text: 请使用 DeepSeek 模型处理这个任务。
切换到 OpenRouter 提供的 Claude Sonnet 模型。

howto.what_en: After adding, Claude can use external AI models via OpenCode, such as DeepSeek, OpenRouter, etc., switching between providers as configured.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent group is configured to use the OpenCode provider, with environment variables like OPENCODE_PROVIDER set.

say_en.text: Please use the DeepSeek model for this task.
Switch to the Claude Sonnet model via OpenRouter.
